request: My fitness is scattered, so I want steps, workout minutes, water and weight in one place, with quick 250 and 500 ml water buttons and a weekly summary that tells me if I am doing better than last week.
program:
app "Fitness Pro" run mint
table steps count num 0..
table workout kind text, mins num 1..300
table weigh kg num 20..300
table water ml num 1..5000
let w_now = last(weigh.kg)
sum(steps.count today) "steps today" big
sum(workout.mins week) "workout min this week," sum(water.ml today) "ml water today" head
form steps, "Add steps"
form workout, "Log workout"
form weigh, "Log weight"
quick water, ml, [250, 500]
trend weigh, it.kg
"Weekly summary" head
stack card gap 1
  if(sum(steps.count week) > sum(steps.count prev week), "Steps up", "Steps down or the same") "vs last week" color if(sum(steps.count week) > sum(steps.count prev week), good, warn)
  if(sum(workout.mins week) > sum(workout.mins prev week), "More workout minutes", "Fewer workout minutes") color if(sum(workout.mins week) > sum(workout.mins prev week), good, warn)
  if(sum(water.ml week) > sum(water.ml prev week), "More water", "Less water") color if(sum(water.ml week) > sum(water.ml prev week), good, warn)
  if(avg(weigh.kg week) < avg(weigh.kg prev week), "Weight down", "Weight not down") color if(avg(weigh.kg week) < avg(weigh.kg prev week), good, muted)

request: A big ring to tap for each coffee run, with a count to ten I can change, and a day streak in big numbers beside it, because I like to see the target reached message when I hit it.
program:
app "Coffee runs" coffee mint
table run_out
setting target num = 10 "Count to"
let n = count(run_out today)
draw width 240 tap add run_out
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * (n % target) / target stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n % target big
  label 50, 64, "Round" floor(n / target) + 1 faint
stat streak(run_out), "day streak"
when n = target notify "Target reached"

request: The safe to spend per day and an over or left figure sit at the top, with a progress bar against my budget. Below that, a way to add a purchase and a list by day to edit.
program:
app "Shopping" bag ink
table purchase what text, amount money, note text?
let spent = sum(purchase.amount month)
setting budget money = 20000 "Monthly budget"
"Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form purchase
list purchase month by day

request: how many books have i finished this year?
program:
app "Reading List" book mint
table book title text, author text, pages num 1..5000, started date?
table finish book ref book, rating num 1..5
"Finished this year" count(finish year) big
"Average rating" round(avg(finish.rating year) * 10) / 10 head
"Pages read per month" head
bars 0..5, sum(finish month of addmonths(today, -it), it.book.pages), monthname(addmonths(today, -it))

      it.author it.pages "pages" faint

request: study subjects for morning afternoon evening, pls
program:
app "Study routine" school plum
table subject name text, part pick Morning|Afternoon|Evening = Morning
table subject_done subject ref subject
let n = count(subject)
screen main "Today" check
  count(subject_done today) "of" n "done today" head
  each subject
    row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
      stack grow
        it.name bold
        it.part faint
      toggle it.subject_done
  form subject
screen stats "Stats" chart
  stat max(subject, streak(it.subject_done)), "best streak"
  stat round(count(subject_done week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% done this week"
  heat last 70 days, count(subject_done on it), n

request: For me, I want a week grid of the five prayers, Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha, where I tap each one I prayed, with a count of prayers this week out of 35.
program:
app "Salah" mosque mint
table prayer name pick Fajr|Zuhr|Asr|Maghrib|Isha
row gap 1
  "" tiny width 5
  each options prayer.name
    it tiny grow align center
each days last 7 days as d
  row gap 1
    dayname(d) tiny width 5
    each options prayer.name as n
      box grow height 28 radius 6 fill if(count(prayer on d where name = n) > 0, accent, soft) tap toggle prayer on d where name = n
"Prayed this week" count(prayer week) "of" 35 faint

request: A Clear done button that wipes finished tasks in one go, because my desk gets cluttered fast. Open tasks show with a count, sorted by priority, with urgent, waiting or idea tags and due dates.
program:
app "Office tasks" bag plum
table work_task title text, done bool, tag pick Urgent|Normal|Waiting|Idea = Urgent, priority pick Low|Normal|High = Normal, due date?
count(work_task where done = no) "open" head
each work_task where done = no sort priority desc as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    toggle t.done
    stack grow
      t.title bold
      t.tag t.due small color if(t.due < today, bad, muted)
form work_task
"Done" faint
list work_task where done = yes
button "Clear done" tap remove all work_task where done = yes

request: A reminder on the day of each birthday, then a list sorted by date with the days left, and a Next year button that rolls past ones forward. A way to add a name and date sits at the bottom.
program:
app "Birthdays Buddy" gift plum
table bday name text, day date
remind "Birthday today" at bday.day
each bday sort day as b
  row card gap 1 tap edit b swipe remove b
    stack grow
      b.name bold
      b.day faint
    b.day - today "days" color if(b.day - today <= 7, warn, muted)
    if b.day < today
      button "Next year" tap set b.day = addmonths(b.day, 12)
form bday, "Add birthday"

request: flashcards shuffle, show me one random card
program:
app "Random cards" book plum
table card word text, meaning text, known bool
state cur num = 1
state flip bool = no
each card sort word as c
  if index = cur - 1
    stack card gap 2 align center tap set flip = not flip
      if flip
        c.meaning big
      else
        c.word big
button "Next random card" tap set cur = random(max(count(card), 1)) then set flip = no
form card, "Add card"
"Known" count(card where known = yes) "of" count(card) faint
